::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/billing_models"}
#docs
Which of `subscriptions`, `one_time`, `usage` and `credits` this business had figures for in the last 90 days. Screens use it to show a model's reports and boards only when there is something to show. An empty list means no model has data yet.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `billing_models`. One of `billing_models`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `models` | `array of string` | The models. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/billing_models" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "billing_models",
  "business": "biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "models": [
    "subscriptions"
  ]
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such business"
  }
}
```
